hero.sub: A gas smell near the water heater, a line the utility red-tagged or an old connector behind the dryer. Our licensed plumbers find leaks, repair gas lines and pressure-test them before we leave. From our office on West Elm Street.

steps.body: Everyone and every pet, out of the house.
Don't flip switches, use phones inside or start a car in an attached garage.
Once you're cleared to go back in, we'll find and fix the leak.

blocks.h2: When Your Gas Piping Needs a Plumber

tiles.body: Near the furnace, water heater, range or dryer.
Service won't come back until the house piping is repaired and tested.
A generator or tankless heater may be too much for the existing line.
Uncoated brass connectors should be replaced.

bodies: If you suspect a leak or the utility shut off service, we find the exact source using electronic detectors and soap tests on the fittings, then pressure-test the system to confirm it's sealed.
Most leaks are at unions, valves and appliance connectors. Once repaired, we test the whole system so service can be restored.

blocks.intro: Most McHenry homes were built since 1970, and many have had appliances added along the way.

items.body: Grills, garage heaters and dryers added later aren't always connected or sized right. We check how they were done.
Detached garages and workshops sometimes get gas through a buried line. Those can leak out of sight.
Standby generators have become common in areas that lose power in storms. They draw a lot of gas, so the line has to be sized for it.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: Gas work done right, then tested.

steps.body: Gas line work should be done by a licensed pro. Ours are licensed and trained for it.
A flat price once we find the problem.
Before the gas comes back on.

blocks.h2: Gas Line Questions From McHenry Homeowners

items.q: What do I do if I smell gas?
items.preview: Leave and call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside.
items.answer: Leave the house right away and don't touch switches. Call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside. Then call us for the repair.

items.q: Can you find a leak on a buried gas line?
items.answer: Yes. Lines to garages, grills and outbuildings are often buried. We can test and locate leaks on them.

items.q: Can my gas line handle a standby generator?
items.preview: Maybe. We calculate the load first.
items.answer: Maybe. Generators draw a lot of gas. We add up your total load and upsize the line if needed.

items.q: Who is responsible for the gas line to my house?
items.preview: The utility up to the meter. You after it.
items.answer: Nicor Gas is responsible up to and including the meter. Piping from the meter to your appliances is yours.

items.q: How much does gas line repair cost in McHenry?
items.preview: It depends on the leak and the line. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the leak is, how much pipe needs work and access. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
